# 对比式自监督表示学习：进展与展望

对比式自监督学习（contrastive self-supervised learning）不依赖人工标签，而是将同一样本的不同增强视图视为正对、其他样本视为负对，在表示空间中拉近正对、推远负对，从而学习具有判别力和迁移性的特征。由于所学表示可迁移到分类、检测、分割等下游任务，该范式已成为视觉预训练的重要方向[8-10]。

其思想可追溯至样本级代理任务。Dosovitskiy 等[1]将每幅图像及其变换视为独立类别，训练卷积网络区分样本；Wu 等[2]提出非参数实例判别，用特征记忆库与噪声对比估计把“实例即类别”推广到大规模数据。MoCo[3]引入动量编码器和队列，使负样本规模不再受批大小限制；PIRL[4]强调表示应对 pretext 变换保持不变；CMC[5]将对比扩展到多视图，揭示视角间互补信息的价值。此后，SimCLR、BYOL、SwAV 与 Barlow Twins 等工作分别从强增广与大 batch、无负样本自蒸馏、聚类分配和冗余消除等角度推进，降低了对负样本的依赖[8,10]。

在结构设计上，SimSiam[6]表明停梯度与预测器足以避免孪生网络坍塌；DINO[7]将自蒸馏用于视觉 Transformer，其冻结特征在语义分割等密集任务上表现突出。理论分析则把对比目标视为互信息下界最大化，并强调对齐性、均匀性、温度系数与增广策略的共同作用[8]。

当前挑战主要包括：大规模负样本带来的算力与存储开销、虚假负样本、增广偏置、批大小敏感以及表示坍塌。未来研究可望围绕高效训练、多模态统一、可信评估与更完整的理论刻画展开。

## 参考文献

[1] Alexey Dosovitskiy, Philipp Fischer, Jost Tobias Springenberg, Martin Riedmiller, Thomas Brox. Discriminative Unsupervised Feature Learning with Exemplar Convolutional Neural Networks. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, 2016, 38(9): 1734–1747. DOI: 10.1109/TPAMI.2015.2496141.

[2] Zhirong Wu, Yuanjun Xiong, Stella X. Yu, Dahua Lin. Unsupervised Feature Learning via Non-Parametric Instance Discrimination. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2018: 3733–3742. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2018.00393.

[3] Kaiming He, Haoqi Fan, Yuxin Wu, Saining Xie, Ross Girshick. Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2020: 9726–9735. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR42600.2020.00975.

[4] Ishan Misra, Laurens van der Maaten. Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Invariant Representations. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2020: 6707–6717. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR42600.2020.00674.

[5] Yonglong Tian, Dilip Krishnan, Phillip Isola. Contrastive Multiview Coding. Computer Vision – ECCV 2020, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, 2020, 12361: 776–794. DOI: 10.1007/978-3-030-58617-1_47.

[6] Xinlei Chen, Kaiming He. Exploring Simple Siamese Representation Learning. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2021: 15750–15760. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR46437.2021.01549.

[7] Mathilde Caron, Hugo Touvron, Ishan Misra, Hervé Jégou, Julien Mairal, Piotr Bojanowski, Armand Joulin. Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2021: 9650–9660. DOI: 10.1109/ICCV48922.2021.00951.

[8] Phuc H. Le-Khac, Graham Healy, Alan F. Smeaton. Contrastive Representation Learning: A Framework and Review. IEEE Access, 2020, 8: 193907–193934. DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2020.3031549.
